notes.title: Bug Fix 0.3
notes.notes: [p]It’s been a while since our last patch. During this time, we've been working hard to fix many of the bugs you've reported and improve the overall stability of the game. [/p][p]Thanks for your patience and continued support![/p][p][/p][p][b]Update Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Issues with the Plater and Grinder machines have been resolved[/p][/*][*][p]Network-related errors have been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaner machine UI has been improved[/p][/*][*][p]HUD has been added for certain objects[/p][/*][*][p]Disconnection issues in multiplayer have been addressed[/p][/*][*][p]Some customer-related bugs have been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Major issues with the cash registers have been largely resolved[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Grinder Machine Fix[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558761/9c11b76c230d00752260b36d27d616680600a179.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Cleaner machine UI upgrade[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558761/1720117453d035390c70131bf36a3f048f686d33.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]HUD has been added for certain objects[/b][/h3][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558761/2c036eb401751d316fb37e4a6691962f3b45f54e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558761/86c0903322c520107f524de9c788275e107c0d45.png"][/img][/carousel][hr][/hr][p][/p]
